purpose: Pending registry for the Windows improvement supplement (W00-W25, WX-01-WX-18). Separate from docs/requirements.json so the original P00-P23 id space keeps its own schema. Regenerate with `node tools/build/seed-windows-ledger.mjs`.

prompts.title: Establish the actual Windows baseline
prompts.deliverable: Reconcile Windows baseline and seed review state
prompts.acceptance: Current source/engine/platform and baseline checks recorded; W tasks indexed with no falsely completed statuses; real existing features preserved; evidence/attempt counts survive validation; no production behavior changed without a targeted finding.
prompts.checkpoint: W00 assessment table, source map, current evidence limitations and next eligible prompt. Do not say this document itself constituted a Windows code review.

prompts.title: Make drafts, navigation and keyboard submission lossless
prompts.acceptance: Deterministic deferred-promise tests cover send→type more, send→switch project/thread, out-of-order saves, duplicate button/shortcut events, uncertain/rejected send and restart. Newer and other-project drafts remain; empty/blocked submissions send nothing; exactly one accepted request occurs for the same user action. Native Windows keyboard smoke covers IME and Ctrl+Enter in the real composer.
prompts.checkpoint: Reproduction and repair evidence or already-satisfied evidence, changed contracts and focused test results for WX-02.

prompts.title: Preserve state integrity and finish export qualification
prompts.deliverable: State cleanup, restore discipline and export dialog
prompts.acceptance: Replacement import/export tests cover associated-row cleanup and unrelated-data preservation; fault injection preserves usable prior state or a recoverable checkpoint; all writers participate in maintenance; dialog cancellation leaves state intact; no model calls from import/export UI.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-03 evidence, any original MONA-007 impact, and exact native checks still pending. Existing working features must remain intact.

prompts.title: Make history complete and streaming identity-correct
prompts.acceptance: Fixtures include >10,000 stored events, >2,000 frames in one turn, interleaved threads/items, heartbeat between deltas, duplicate replay and genuine gaps. Old content remains reachable; no ALPHA/BETA cross-thread merge; no duplicated completed card; scrolling while reading is not hijacked. Paging makes no provider calls.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-04 projection/paging contract, bounded rendering observations and Windows long-session smoke.

prompts.title: Add useful descriptions to native command autocomplete
prompts.acceptance: A coverage fixture reconciles every pinned registry row and alias; no unexplained omission or invented route. Test keyboard/IME, cursor replacement, multiline paste, literal text, Narrator semantics and large scaling. Filtering/help makes zero inference calls.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-05 versioned catalog and provenance, coverage matrix, actual composer captures and routing work left for W05.

prompts.title: Execute commands correctly and qualify a real new conversation
prompts.acceptance: Positive/negative dispatch for every executable route; argument injection refused; `/new` idle/busy/disconnected/response-lost/restart/project-switch cases; old histories/drafts remain accessible; chosen provider and permission posture unchanged. Unsupported native semantics are a recorded blocker, not hidden by keystroke automation.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-05 command-to-native matrix with receipts and old/new identities; a shared new-conversation operation ready for Prompt Runner.

prompts.title: Deliver Focus Studio and true Windows fullscreen
prompts.deliverable: Focus and native Windows fullscreen Studio
prompts.acceptance: Actual Windows tests enter/leave while streaming, typing, scrolled back, answering input and opening drawers. No remounted engine or new inference; draft/caret/scroll survives. Alt+Tab, F11/menu exit, minimize/restore and close/quit remain usable. Narrow and 200% layouts keep essential controls reachable.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-06 native state trace and normal/focus/fullscreen screenshots; separate any real-monitor check still unavailable.

prompts.title: Make Aurora Studio visibly more expressive
prompts.acceptance: Inspect actual rendered before/after screenshots for both themes/intensities, normal/fullscreen, long content, tool failures, Needs the Human, empty state and narrow/200% layouts. Measure contrast on real foreground/background pairs. No idle animation CPU regression, hidden focus or inaccessible status color.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-07 visual evidence, token decisions and performance observations. A stylesheet diff alone is not visual verification.

prompts.title: Let the human answer actual agent requests
prompts.acceptance: Native/fixture request round trip, rejected or expired answer, duplicate click, lost acknowledgement, reconnect and concurrent request IDs. “Delivered” requires an acknowledgement. Dismissing UI does not approve. Text drafts survive. Complete independent display/state work if a native reply capability blocks final verification.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-08 actual route/evidence and a reusable structured request surface for Needs the Human.

prompts.title: Make watching and communicating with agents enjoyable
prompts.acceptance: Completion during typing, cancellation at dispatch boundary, thread/project switch, reconnect, uncertain send, paused queue and child-agent cases. Exactly one dispatcher controls the workspace; queued and delivered are distinct; no accidental spend from browsing activity. Windows notifications are quiet/deduplicated under existing settings.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-08 message-intention contract, event provenance and actual Studio walkthrough.

prompts.title: Put honest usage and controls in the slim dashboard
prompts.deliverable: Factual slim dashboard, costs and budgets
prompts.acceptance: Usage fixtures cover cache hit/miss, inclusive reasoning/output, missing price, parent/child totals, delayed updates, duplicate replay and scope changes. HUD controls work at 200%. Browsing the dashboard causes no provider call; configured gates block the actual dispatch path.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-09 cost provenance/coverage and focused mathematical/dispatch tests.

prompts.title: Add everyday composition, navigation and review conveniences
prompts.acceptance: No wrong-project insertion; cancellation preserves draft; supported attachment context is shown accurately; invalid/outside-root/reparse cases follow the existing policy; links cannot cross IPC/renderer privilege boundaries. Keyboard, large text and error/cancel states work. Local lookup/copy/search adds no inference.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-10 before/after workflow evidence and any concrete unsupported capability still open.

prompts.title: Apply the approved Mona icon across Windows
prompts.acceptance: Inspect installed icons at small/large sizes and high DPI; the packaged binary carries the correct artwork; shortcuts bind the intended executable/app identity; no stretched, white-matted or missing images.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-11 asset provenance, generated sizes and actual installed captures; preserve any missing-source blocker.

evidence.note: Artwork embedded in the packaged executable and verified on installed bytes; the ICO container was invalid and is fixed. Open: a physical high-DPI visual check of the installed icon.

prompts.title: Define Prompt Runner ownership and result contracts
prompts.deliverable: Prompt Runner contract and state model
prompts.acceptance: State/schema tests reject stale/mismatched/partial reports and distinguish acceptance, turn completion and evidence verification. Migration/backup approach preserves existing project state. No new paid orchestration layer.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-12 contract and decision note; portable scheduling logic with Windows integrations at existing boundaries.

evidence.note: Runner contract and durable state model landed as migration 10 over the existing task engine; 15 tests. Execution/import/UI are W14-W17.

prompts.notes: Runner contract and durable state model landed as migration 10 over the existing task engine; 15 tests. Execution/import/UI are W14-W17.

prompts.title: Import numbered prompt files into a clear, inert plan
prompts.acceptance: Real-file fixtures and synthetic cases cover headings in fenced code, multiple prefixes, shared rules, Unicode/spaced paths, missing dependencies and reimports. Preview text matches what will be submitted. Importing/selecting does not create a thread, invoke a model or execute imported instructions.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-12 parser/manifest contract, exact preview screenshots and accepted source-format limitations.

prompts.title: Run the selected sequence automatically and durably
prompts.acceptance: Fake runtime proves three prompts run in order in distinct threads, with one accepted send per dispatch and no extra task afterward. Duplicate events, double Start, response loss, concurrent UI/manual dispatch and restart do not duplicate work. A busy native workflow or uncertain active turn prevents another mutating task.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-12 transition traces and durable submission/recovery evidence. Do not launch the real development sequence with this runner until W18 qualifies it.

prompts.title: Gate progress on evidence and collect Needs the Human
prompts.deliverable: Verification, blockers and Needs the Human
prompts.acceptance: Third no-progress attempt, dependent/independent branches, stale evidence, native request still holding a turn, malformed report, human-only check, expired/duplicate answer and explicit skip all have correct outcomes. Unanswered required work is never complete. Reports distinguish all verified from finished with blockers.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-13 inbox and completion provenance, actual state transitions and unresolved engine reply limits.

prompts.title: Integrate the runner into Studio and Windows lifecycle
prompts.deliverable: Runner UI, spending and lifecycle controls
prompts.acceptance: Native Windows/fixture tests cover stop races, view/thread switches, minimize/restore, sleep recovery, close confirmation, power-request cleanup and late usage. UI operations make zero inference calls. Keyboard/fullscreen/200% layouts retain the controls.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-14 lifecycle/action semantics, actual UI captures and precise platform limits.

prompts.title: Qualify Prompt Runner failures and document its use
prompts.deliverable: Runner fault qualification and user guide
prompts.acceptance: Every matrix row has evidence or a precise blocker; no duplicate model effects, lost attempts or false task completion. Runner tests work without development-only paths in the recipient package. The feature is not called fully qualified if native/reply tests remain unavailable.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-12/WX-13/WX-14 qualification and usable guide; authorize future real queues only through the user's explicit selection/start action.

prompts.title: Profile memory and repair demonstrated performance problems
prompts.acceptance: Comparable before/after measurements and relevant regression checks; no loss of features, accessibility or inference parity. Report current target pass/miss with practical remaining options. If still above target, retain the performance criterion open pending repair or an explicit release exception. CPU and long-history interaction are also measured.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-15 reproducible method/results, source/artifact identity and any unresolved D-0104 decision. Repeat final measurements only if later changes materially affect them.

evidence.note: Measured before/after on the installed artifact; no app-level leak found; the 350 MiB idle target is still missed and stays open.
Measured before/after on the installed artifact; no app-level leak found; the 350 MiB idle target is still missed and stays open.
Measured before/after on the installed artifact; no app-level leak found; the 350 MiB idle target is still missed and stays open.

prompts.title: Complete Windows accessibility and real scaling checks
prompts.acceptance: Required native/human observations have real evidence; otherwise retain exact unverified criteria and a short checklist with expected results. Do not claim Narrator passed from DOM attributes or physical DPI passed from emulated zoom. Fix observed defects and rerun affected paths.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-16 and original MONA-028 traceability, observed configuration, outstanding human tests and accessible screenshots where relevant.

evidence.note: Accessibility tree was not exposed to Windows at all; fixed and verified through UI Automation. Narrator, exact 200 % scaling, text size, contrast and IME remain human checks.
Accessibility tree was not exposed to Windows at all; fixed and verified through UI Automation. Narrator, exact 200 % scaling, text size, contrast and IME remain human checks.

prompts.title: Reconcile regressions and evidence against final source
prompts.acceptance: Required checks on the actual candidate pass or remain explicit release blockers. No claimed Windows-native result is supported only by a foreign host/mock. Original and enhancement ledgers agree about completed, stale, partial and blocked work.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-01 regression/economics/security evidence summary with exact source identity. Later code changes invalidate only relevant evidence and require the corresponding final check.

evidence.note: Full CI green on the settled candidate; both ledgers reconcile.

prompts.notes: Full CI green on the settled candidate; both ledgers reconcile.

prompts.title: Resolve modern Explorer menu and trust honestly
prompts.deliverable: Modern Explorer menu and signing/trust qualification
prompts.acceptance: Modern-menu invocation is observed under the declared trust state. Test trust is not production distribution. Failed trust/registration remains MONA-027 blocked; classic success does not close it. Installer/uninstaller remove only their own registration.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-17 exact native/trust evidence and the smallest actionable human prerequisite, with all independent engineering work complete.

evidence.note: Shell verb invocation observed; trust chain and the 0x800B0109 condition diagnosed. Open: a human right-click showing the item in the Windows 11 menu (MONA-027).

prompts.title: Produce an installer that a recipient can use
prompts.deliverable: Installer, upgrade, uninstall and clean recipient
prompts.acceptance: Local/test candidate has a demonstrable recipient installation path and lifecycle evidence on its actual bytes. W22 signing/trust or licensing gaps remain explicit release gates; do not call an untrusted package frictionless friend-ready distribution. Installer work can complete without pretending those external decisions are made.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-18 exact installer filename, architecture, dependency/network story, lifecycle results and unresolved distribution prerequisites.

evidence.note: One unsigned setup file installs/upgrades/uninstalls per user; the modern-menu package remains gated on certificate trust.

prompts.title: Qualify the packaged candidate and release claims
prompts.deliverable: Packaged workflows, timings and release gate
prompts.acceptance: Actual packaged timings/workflows and artifact identity are recorded. A development smoke or a source checkout is not substituted. Signed-distribution readiness is claimed only for the final validated package and resolved mandatory gates; full 1.0 still requires the original complete scope.
prompts.checkpoint: WX-15/WX-18 release gate matrix, final artifact path/hash and precise remaining actions.

prompts.title: Leave a complete, honest handoff
prompts.acceptance: Every task accounted for; docs match behavior; no falsely green requirement; no leaked secrets; the next session can resume without rediscovering context. A closure prompt may finish with an accurate blocked-task report; it does not mark the blocked tasks complete.
